name: falsify_c5_expects_succeeded
description: FALSIFICATION of the status and early-check judgements. Identical to c5_same_clip_twice except that clip 1 expects succeeded and duplicate=false. The run is the normal one and the two checks are judged independently, so it must exit 1 with BOTH [status_mismatch, probe_mismatch] on clip 1. Either code alone means the other check did not act on the live observation; each check failing on its own is shown by the pure-function tests.
